title: Maze Munch
core_verb: Steer through a fixed grid maze to eat every pellet while avoiding ghosts.
fantasy: A maze-eating chase in which one character clears food from corridors while ghosts pursue it.
fail_state: A ghost catches you while you are not powered, removing one life and resetting positions; you lose when lives reach zero from an initial 3.
win_state: Collect all 60 regular pellets and 4 power pellets so the remaining pellet count reaches zero.

interaction_tags.meaning: Moving maze hazard; contact removes one life unless the 6-second power timer is active, in which case the ghost returns to its spawn.
Regular corridor collectible; collecting it decrements the remaining pellet count by one.
Required goal collectible; collecting it decrements the remaining pellet count by one and enables eating ghosts for 6 seconds.

notes: Pac-Man's repeating multi-level structure is reduced to one fixed 15-by-15 grid maze containing 64 total pellets, 3 pursuing ghosts, and 3 player lives.

scene.description: A top-down maze of blue walls on a black floor, every corridor exactly one cell wide. Pellets line every open path, power pellets pulse larger in the four corners, and a ghost spawn pen sits in the centre. Packed: the walls are the visual, and movement is entirely through the corridor gaps.
